author: tbolt
description: A lean, local-first task board. Add tasks with quick-add syntax (#tags, +subtasks, due dates), assign people, track progress, and get a weekly digest. Data lives on your NAS.

tips.before_install:
## Task Board

Data (tasks, people, activity log) is stored on your ZimaOS disk at `/DATA/AppData/task-board/`, so it survives container rebuilds and is shared across every browser on your network.

title: Task Board
release_note: - Initial release: self-hosted task board with on-NAS storage.
